title: Dani DaOrtiz at Fool US 2022 (the act that Penn and Teller didn’t even try to figure out.)
summary: A ten-minute card-magic act by Dani DaOrtiz performed on Penn & Teller: Fool Us in 2022. It is built on timing, misdirection and psychology, and the method defeated the show's hosts.
why: HN commenters repeatedly call it among the best magic performances ever, valuing it as acting and craft that stays impressive even once you know the method.

quote.text: This is one of the greatest performances of all time
